title: Relative derived exchange along a limit of smooth schemes
statement: Let k be a field, D:I -> Over(Spec k) a small cofiltered diagram of smooth qcqs structure maps with affine transitions, and c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting and whose structure map is qcqs. Let f:X -> Spec k be qcqs and F an abelian etale sheaf killed by n, where n is nonzero in k. Then c.pt.hom^* Rf_*(F[0]) is isomorphic to Rf\prime_*((p^*F)[0]) for the cartesian square with c.pt.hom [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Construct a module sheaf M over ULift(Z/n) with underlying abelian sheaf F. Its stalks are n-torsion. The image of n in global functions of Spec k is a unit, so M has torsion of invertible order.

At each smooth stage apply the proved single-sheaf case of bounded-below derived smooth base change for M. The module/abelian canonical exchange compatibility and exact forgetful-functor single comparison transport this to the abelian canonical exchange for F. Cancel the comparison isomorphism.
Apply the derived limit-exchange theorem to the resulting stage isomorphisms. The coefficient and empty-source edge cases are preserved.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 59.89.3, field-base degree-zero specialization; formal specialization and comparisons by X2

theorem nonempty_smoothLimit_derivedDirectImage_single_iso
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, Smooth (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : k) ≠ 0)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : n • 𝟙 F = 0) :
    Nonempty
      (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} c.pt.hom).mapDerivedCategory).obj
          ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) ≅
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd f c.pt.hom)).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst f c.pt.hom)).obj F)))
